tools.name: describe_quantum_capabilities
tools.title: Discover RQM quantum capabilities and domain guidance
tools.description: Free, anonymous API-owned scientific capability contracts and domain suggestions. Start here before choosing or funding a quantum job. Inspect separate source, installed, hosted, simulator, live-QPU and public coverage; unknown means unverified. Read schemas, examples and limits; unavailable chemistry, cryptography or hybrid workflows must not be replaced with Bell or promised as execution. This finite registry is not the complete roadmap. Workflow tool references do not promise availability on this endpoint or eligibility for the caller. No account, balance, job, private policy, quote, reservation or hardware execution is accessed. Existing authenticated tools own those operations.

tools.title: List RQM service contracts
tools.description: List supported quantum software services, their input requirements, evidence limits, readiness and separately exposed tool names. Free descriptive read; performs no computation, submission, quote or spending authorization.

tools.name: search_buyer_jobs
tools.title: Search RQM service contracts
tools.description: Search supported quantum software services by a concrete objective. Returns candidate descriptions, input requirements, readiness, evidence limits and references to the separately exposed tools. Free descriptive read; performs no computation, purchase or spending authorization.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.title: Read prepaid RQM balance
tools.description: Read the connected account's prepaid USD balance before considering an account-funded job. To add credits yourself, open https://www.rqmtechnologies.com/account/credits and sign in with the same RQM account connected here. Wait for confirmed funds, then read this balance again. A positive balance does not establish saved spending-policy readiness or permission for a particular purchase. Does not fund the account or authorize spending.

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core balance response. Available prepaid balance is not permission to spend or proof of saved policy readiness.

tools.name: get_account_job
tools.title: Recover an account-funded job
tools.description: Read this agent's saved account-funded job by its returned job ID to check status and recover available result and receipt. Use after submission or when following up on an existing purchase; acceptance is not completion. Report the saved state and only available results, with their limitations. If the job ID was lost, use list_account_jobs with the original idempotency key first. Never authorizes another purchase.

job_id.description: UUID returned for the saved account job. Recover a missing ID with list_account_jobs using the original purchase idempotency key; do not invent an ID or submit again.

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core saved-job response. Interpret the saved status before claiming completion; result and receipt availability depends on job state and saved version.

tools.name: list_account_jobs
tools.title: Find this agent's purchases
tools.description: List up to 100 recent jobs for this agent, or find the original account-funded purchase using its idempotency key. Use for purchase history and recovery before retrying an uncertain submission; use list_buyer_jobs or search_buyer_jobs for available services. Omit the key for recent history, or pass the exact original key to recover one purchase. Use a returned job ID with get_account_job for saved status, result and receipt. An empty response does not prove that a timed-out submission cannot still be accepted; preserve the original key and inputs on any retry. This read never purchases or reruns a job.

idempotency_key.description: Exact original purchase key from the named operation. Supply it to recover an uncertain submission; omit to list recent jobs. Do not generate a replacement key for recovery.

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core job-list response with jobs for this agent. A supplied idempotency key filters recovery to the original purchase; without it, returns up to 100 recent jobs.
